newsitem.title: USA: BEFORE THE BELL - Motorola off but rising off low.
newsitem.headline: BEFORE THE BELL - Motorola off but rising off low.

text.p: Shares in Motorola Inc pared losses in Wednesday pre-open activity, rebounding to 47-1/2 after dropping as low as 46 on news of a profit warning.
Early this moring, Motorola said third quarter earnings may be significantly below those of the second quarter, as well as below analysts' consensus estimate of $0.50 per share.
The shares ended yesterday's New York Stock Exchange regular session at 50-3/4.
The American Depositary Receipts of Telefon AB L.M. Ericsson and Nokia fell as the Motorola outlook rattled similar stocks.
"They are all down on the Motorola news," a trader said.
Nokia fell to 40-1/8 from 41-1/4 and Ericsson traded at 23-3/8, off 5/8.
Also, Electronics for Imaging Inc traded sharply higher ahead of the market open to 70 from 66-1/4.
Prudential Securities upgraded he stock buy from hold, according to the analyst's office, a move traders cited for the stock rise.

Elsewhere, Reuters Holdings Plc Nasdaq-listed ADRs rose 1-1/2 to 71-1/2 ahead of the open after the company announced it intends to return 613 million British pounds to shareholders over three year via a new class of special dividend shares.
